title: MIRROR: Learning from the Other View for Multi-Modal Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2607.21552v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) can behave very differently depending on whether the same underlying problem is presented textually or visually. This inconsistency suggests that different views expose different reasoning paths and failure modes that standard multimodal post-training does not fully exploit. To study and exploit this phenomenon, we construct ODA-Data, a high-quality paired multimodal geometry dataset with text-dominant, image-dominant, and combined image+text views of the same problems, together with splits for training and evaluating view dependent reasoning behaviors. We then develop Modality-Informed Reciprocal Reasoning Optimization (MIRROR), a reinforcement learning approach that derives a cross-view self-distillation signal from the model's own modality-dependent capabilities. For each problem, MIRROR evaluates the model under all views, selects the best-performing view as a teacher, and trains the remaining views

translated_title: MIRROR：从另一视角学习以实现多模态推理
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言模型在处理同一个底层问题时，若问题以文本形式或视觉形式呈现，其表现可能截然不同。这种不一致性表明，不同的视角会暴露出不同的推理路径和失败模式，而标准的多模态后训练方法并未充分加以利用。为了研究和利用这一现象，我们构建了ODA-Data，一个高质量的成对多模态几何数据集，其中同一问题具有文本主导、图像主导以及图像+文本组合三种视角，并附带用于训练和评估视角相关推理行为的数据划分。随后，我们提出了模态感知互惠推理优化，这是一种强化学习方法，它从模型自身的模态依赖能力中提取跨视角自蒸馏信号。对于每个问题，MIRROR会在所有视角下评估模型，选择表现最佳的视角作为教师，并对其余视角进行训练……
tldr: 本文提出MIRROR强化学习方法，通过在同一问题的不同模态视角中选取模型表现最佳者作为教师，实现跨视角自蒸馏，从而提升多模态推理能力。
en_tdlr: MIRROR is a reinforcement learning approach that selects the model's best-performing modality view of each problem as a teacher for cross-view self-distillation, thereby improving multi-modal reasoning.
